name: Mural
currentLocation: University of Iowa Stanley Museum of Art
shortDescription: An eight-metre canvas commissioned for Guggenheim's townhouse hallway.
description: Guggenheim commissioned this mural-sized canvas for the entrance hall of her New York townhouse. Pollock is said to have finished the entire painting in a single overnight sitting, working right up to the deadline of its unveiling party.

appearances.note: The commission, the deadline, and the party where it was unveiled.

name: Bird in Space
shortDescription: A polished bronze sculpture Guggenheim bought directly from Brancusi's studio in Paris.
description: Guggenheim visited Brancusi's Paris studio and came away with one of his soaring, abstracted bird forms, a sculpture that would later travel with her collection to Venice.

appearances.note: Buying the sculpture directly from the artist's studio.

name: The Antipope
shortDescription: A strange, crowded canvas Ernst painted not long after marrying Guggenheim.
description: Painted the year of their marriage, the canvas is often read as an oblique portrait of their relationship, populated with the horse-headed and bird-headed figures that recur throughout Ernst's work.

appearances.note: One of the paintings from the period of their marriage.
